visual_language.direction: massive typography style, oversized bold sans-serif dominating the screen, high-impact visual scale, graphic tension, near-full-bleed type, confident and unforgettable statement

legacy_payload.best_for: 以占据半屏以上的超大标题制造第一眼冲击与记忆点
legacy_payload.visual_direction: massive typography style, oversized bold sans-serif dominating the screen, high-impact visual scale, graphic tension, near-full-bleed type, confident and unforgettable statement

canvas.background: white or a single bold color, often minimal
canvas.composition: one enormous statement, tiny or no supporting element

color_palette.primary: white #FFFFFF / one bold ground, near-black type #111111
color_palette.accent: one saturated accent #E11D48 for a key word
color_palette.rule: bold, saturated, high-impact; a single color burst

typography.title: enormous bold sans-serif (Arial Black / 思源黑体 Heavy), full dramatic scale
typography.text_quality: exact word; exaggerate scale, not content

layout_patterns: optical align giant type + tiny caption
legacy_payload.layout_usage_rule: One enormous statement per slide; exaggerate scale, keep content to the absolute minimum.

visual_elements.allowed: giant type, scale contrast, one accent color burst, near-bleed layout, tiny caption
visual_elements.avoid: cluttered, multiple competing elements, busy infographic, decoration

rendering_constraints: High-impact; the type IS the design.
One statement, one color burst at most.
Exact wording; no invented brand marks.
Lock the subject, title, composition, palette, and ratio; keep one hero visual and a strong title hierarchy. Avoid collage/showcase-board output. (awesome-gpt-image-2 · poster-layout-system)

When type is the hero, spelling must be exact and any figure/object/landscape serves the title meaning. Avoid default font effects, irrelevant icons, and over-many colors. (awesome-gpt-image-2 · conceptual-typography-poster)
